verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a REST API that covers inference and also automates management of models, deployments, datasets, and more. A published OpenAPI 3.1 'Gateway REST API' spec covers accounts, deployment, model and training endpoints, alongside REST-based custom model upload for CI/CD and firectl commands for deployment and autoscaling config. The OpenAPI probe 404s only on standard paths; the spec is published at gateway.openapi.yaml and listed in llms.txt, so this is not a contradiction. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement, API evidence for billing controls (auto reload, spend limits) and the guided fine-tuning flow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
